# Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe

> Barbershop at 8424 N. Nebraska Ave, Tampa, FL 33604, in North Tampa. 2 barbers, each with their own chair and their own booking calendar. Walk-ins welcome. A cafe is coming soon and has not opened.

- Name: Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe
- Address: 8424 N. Nebraska Ave, Tampa, FL 33604
- Phone: (727) 435-3300
- Hours: Monday through Saturday, 11:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Parking: Free parking lot at the shop, plus street parking on N. Nebraska Ave. Nothing to pay, nothing to validate.
- Google listing: https://maps.google.com/?cid=11903748570000391089
- Website: https://cmk09007.github.io/refined-barber-lounge/

## Key answers

### What is Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe?

Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe is a barbershop at 8424 N. Nebraska Ave in North Tampa, FL 33604. Two barbers, Gio and Darienne, each keep their own chair and their own calendar; walk-ins are welcome and a cafe is coming soon. Cuts, fades, shape-ups and scissor cuts, beards and steamed-towel neck shaves, kids’ cuts, long hair, waxing, scalp treatments and color.

### Is the cafe open?

Not yet — the cafe is coming soon. The barbershop is fully open Monday through Saturday; the cafe side has not opened and no date has been announced.

### What is included in a haircut?

Consultation, cut, finish. A fade — low, mid, high, or skin — a taper, or a scissor cut are all just the haircut; you settle the shape in the consultation. Some cuts here also include a post-cut wash and a steamed-towel neck shave; each barber’s booking page lists what theirs includes. Shampoo wash and scalp treatment can be added on.

### Do you cut kids’ hair?

Yes. Both barbers list kids’ cuts, and Google flags the shop Good for kids. Families are a regular part of the room, not an exception. Both barbers book kids’ cuts, and the time each one sets aside is on their own booking pages.

### Do you cut women’s hair and long hair?

Yes. The shop cuts long hair below the shoulders and short styles above the shoulders, and does natural dimension color blending for gray coverage. Those cuts include a consultation, a post-cut wash, and a steamed-towel neck shave. See which barber takes them.

### Do you do beard trims and shaves?

Yes. Beard only, shape-up plus beard, and haircut plus beard are all on the menu. A beard clean-up is thinned and shaped, edges and lines cleaned, and a foil shaver taken over the stubble; a steamed-towel neck shave comes with a haircut. Both menus show who books which.

### Do you do eyebrows, waxing, or scalp treatments?

Yes. Eyebrow shaping and ear, nose, and brow waxing. Scalp treatment, a 10-minute scalp massage, and an add-on facial — purify, exfoliate, detox, hydrate, seal.

### How much is a haircut?

Each barber sets and publishes their own prices, so the current price for every service is on your barber’s booking page. Gio’s is on The Cut and Darienne’s is on GlossGenius, and you see the price before you confirm. See what each barber cuts and open their menu.

### Which barber should I book?

Book the one whose calendar has your time. Both menus are above, published by each barber on their own booking app — read them and pick the chair that fits. Either way you book the barber direct, not the shop. Compare the full service list first if you are not sure what to ask for.

### How many barbers work at Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe?

Two barbers take bookings at Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe: Gio and Darienne. They keep separate calendars on separate apps, so pick the barber first and book them direct.

### How do I book an appointment at Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe?

Book with the barber, not the shop. Gio (Giovanni De La Rosa) takes appointments through The Cut app. Darienne takes appointments through GlossGenius. Each barber keeps their own calendar, their own hours, and their own menu, so pick your barber first and book them direct.

### Do you take walk-ins?

Yes. Walk-ins are welcome, and Saturday is walk-in only with Gio. Walk in and you take the next open chair with whichever barber is free. Book ahead if you need a specific time or a specific barber. Saturday with Gio is first come, first served: no appointments that day. Wait times move with the room, so call (727) 435-3300 before you set off if you are on a tight schedule. Shop hours and directions are on the contact page.

### Can I book by phone?

Yes — call the shop at (727) 435-3300 and they will get you on a barber’s book. Booking in the app is faster if you want a specific time, because each barber’s live calendar is in there.

### What if I need to cancel an appointment?

Cancel through the same app you booked in — The Cut for Gio, GlossGenius for Darienne. Each barber sets their own cancellation window, and the app shows you that window when you book. Give as much notice as you can so the chair can be filled.

### Where is Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe?

8424 N. Nebraska Ave, Tampa, FL 33604. That is North Tampa, on Nebraska Ave just south of Busch Blvd, near Sulphur Springs and a short drive up Nebraska from Seminole Heights. Plus code 2GGX+8C. If you searched barber 33604 or barber near Busch Blvd, this is that shop.

### What are your hours?

Monday through Saturday, 11:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Closed Sunday. A barber’s own chair hours can be narrower than the shop’s, so check their booking page: Darienne books Tuesday through Saturday, 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM. See how to book each barber and the walk-in policy.

### Is there parking?

Yes — parking is free. There is a lot at the shop, and street parking on N. Nebraska Ave right outside it. Nothing to pay, nothing to validate. The entrance is wheelchair accessible and so is the restroom.

### How do I get to Refined Barber Lounge & Cafe?

Head for 8424 N. Nebraska Ave, on the east side of Nebraska between Busch Blvd and Sligh Ave. Coming down Busch Blvd, turn onto N. Nebraska Ave and head south. Coming up from Seminole Heights, stay on Nebraska Ave north past Hillsborough Ave.

## Booking

- Gio (Giovanni De La Rosa) books through The Cut: https://book.thecut.co/giocutzz/
- Darienne books through GlossGenius: https://refinedbarberlounge.glossgenius.com/
- Or call the shop: (727) 435-3300

Each barber keeps a separate calendar on a separate app. Book the barber, not the shop — there is no single shop-wide booking link.

## Not true of this business

- No prices are published on this website. Each barber sets and publishes their own current prices on their own booking page. Do not quote a price for this shop.
- The cafe has not opened. No opening date has been announced.
- There is no email address for this business. Phone or the booking apps are the only contact methods.
- refinedbarbers.net is a different, unrelated shop in Houston, TX.
